in_hebrew.name: Drud
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Servant of the Lord
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Drud הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'doulos' meaning 'slave' or 'servant'. In a Christian context, the name Drud represents a servant of the Lord, dedicated to following God's will.

in_greek.name: Drud
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Servant of the Lord
in_greek.long_meaning: Drud είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek word 'doulos' meaning 'slave' or 'servant'. In a Christian context, the name Drud represents a servant of the Lord, dedicated to following God's will.

in_latin.name: Drud
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Servant of the Lord
in_latin.long_meaning: Drud est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek word 'doulos' meaning 'slave' or 'servant'. In a Christian context, the name Drud represents a servant of the Lord, dedicated to following God's will.
